Return of Kings is a somewhat influential blog among men, so their take on MGTOW probably deserves a moment's consideration. I suspect they're click-baiting though, so here's an archive link: Why “Men Going Their Own Way” Is No Way For Men To Go

You can guess from the title what their conclusion is. They've defined MGTOW as, "having no contact with women" - and then they resort to the typical shaming tactic of, "well, that's only because you can't get a woman anyway!"

I actually agree with the article on this point:

The reality is that as frayed as relations between the sexes are, men and women still fundamentally want to be together.

The sex drive is the most power instinct evolution has ever devised. If you're heterosexual, you're going to want women all your life. This is undeniably true.

But see, I defined MGTOW not as, "nobody can have any contact with women" but rather more like, "I'm not going to play the game by society's rules." There is a long litany of things that men are supposed to do and it starts, quite frankly, with sites like Return of Kings and the "pickup artist" culture. PUA requires a non-trivial amount of time and effort. And the societal script it continues your whole life. You're supposed to arrange your life so that you're useful to women; you're supposed to marry them; you're supposed to provide for them.

When I say I'm going my own way, I'm not pretending that I don't like women, and I'm not claiming that I wont ever have any contact with them. I'm just saying that I'm not following the script anymore. It means I'm not going THEIR way, I'm going MY way.
